 Judgment

This is claimant's appeal for enhancement of compensation awarded by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge &
CJM & Addl. MACT, Bidar (hereinafter referred to as 'the Tribunal' for short) in MVC No.430/2022 dated 12.09.2023.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:3769
Though this appeal is stated for orders, with the consent of both the side, it is taken up for final disposal.
2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to as per their ranks before the Tribunal.
3. Brief facts of the case are that Smt.Kalavati was going on motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-38/L-6333 on 24.10.2021 on Chimkod-Gadgi road.
At the place of incident, due to rash and negligent riding of motorcycle by its rider they met with an accident.
Smt.Kalavati sustained grievous fatal injuries and while undergoing treatment in BRIMS hospital, Bidar, she succumbed to the injuries.

sentences.text: 2 4. The further contentions of the claimants are that, they are children of deceased.
The deceased was aged about 45 years and she was labourer and earning Rs.20,000/- per month and out of the said income she was maintaining the family.
With these reasons, the claimants prayed to award compensation of Rs.20,50,000/-.
Respondent No.2/insurer denied contents of the claim petition and prayed for dismissal of the claim petition.
6. From the rival contentions of the parties, the Tribunal had framed the necessary issues for its determination.
7. The claimants to prove their case examined PW.1 and got marked Exs.P1 to 10 and closed their evidence.
Respondents have not led any evidence.
8. After hearing both the parties and appreciating the evidence available on record, the Tribunal by its impugned judgment, awarded the following amount of compensation.
Sl. No Heads Amount
1 . Loss of dependency Rs.18,19,944/-.

2. Loss of consortium Rs.44,000/-.
 3. Loss to estate Rs.16,500/-

4. Transportation of dead body and Rs.16,500/-
 funeral expenses.

Heard arguments of learned counsel for the appellant and respondent No.2.
10.
The learned counsel for the appellants submits that the Tribunal has not properly considered the income of the deceased and amount of compensation awarded on other heads are also on lower side.

Therefore prayed to enhance the compensation.
11.
Learned counsel for respondent No.2 supported the impugned judgment and submitted that there are no grounds to interfere with the findings of the Tribunal.
Hence, prayed for dismissal of the appeal.
12. The following question arises for determination.
"Whether the claimants are entitled for the enhancement of compensation?

3 13.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The fact of accident, death of Smt.Kalavati due to injuries sustained in the accident are not in dispute and there is no need to reconsider the same.
14. Accident had taken place on 24.10.2021.

The Tribunal has taken notional income as Rs.13,000/-
per NC: 2024:KHC-K:3769 month which is lower side.

As per chart prepared by the KSLSA in consultation with stakeholders, income of the victim of an accident of the year 2021 as Rs.14,250/-;
deceased was aged about 45 years and hence 25% of the income has to be added towards future prospects.
The Tribunal had applied proper multiplier as well as deducted 1/3rd towards personal expenses.
On the basis of the said calculation the amount of compensation is recalculated under the head of loss of dependency.
15. The amount of compensation awarded towards consortium is also on lower side, which needs to be enhanced.

Accordingly, the following amount of compensation is recalculated as under:
 Sl. Heads Amount Amount  No awarded by the awarded by this  Tribunal court

1 . Loss of dependency Rs.18,19,944/- Rs.19,95,000/-
 (14,250+25%x12x14x1/3rd)
 2. Loss of consortium Rs.44,000/- Rs.88,000/-
 3. Loss of estate Rs.16,500/- Rs.16,500/-
4 . Funeral expenses Rs.16,500/- Rs.16,500/-
The claimants are entitled for enhancement of compensation of Rs.2,19,056/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum.

Accordingly, I answer the above question partly in the affirmative and pass following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed in part.

ii. The impugned judgment and award passed by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge & CJM & Addl. MACT, Bidar, in MVC.No.430/2022 dated 12.09.2023 is modified;
(a) An amount of Rs.2,19,056/- is enhanced in addition to compensation awarded by the Tribunal with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. on the enhanced amount of compensation from the date of petition till realization of said amount.
iii. Respondent No.2 - insurance company shall deposit the said amount with interest before NC:
2024:KHC-K:3769 the Tribunal within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
